programme.title: Larry Graham
programme.sub-title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham & Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers' came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career. It is often said that Graham pioneered the art of slap-pop playing on the electric bass, which has become a staple of modern funk. During this Paris performance, Graham shows he is one of the heroes of funk!

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Tony Bennett
programme.desc: Relive the magic of one of the most beloved crooners in music history in his prime: Tony Bennett! Recorded live in London's Royal Albert Hall on March 2, 1974, this enchanting performance showcases Bennett's remarkable vocal prowess and charisma to full effect. Bennett is accompanied by his musical director Torrie Zito and an orchestra of British musicians that includes Kenny Clare (drums), Don Lusher (trombone), and Kenny Baker (trumpet). Tune in for Bennett's captivating take on songs “The Good Things in Life”, “My Favorite Things”, “My Love”, “I've Got Five Dollars”, “It Don't Mean a Thing”, and “Maybe This Time” in this magical concert recording.

programme.title: Marcus Miller
programme.desc: This portrait of Marcus Miller was recorded during his 2009 ‘Tutu Revisited' tour. Miller looks back on his relationship with Miles Davis. Miller tells us about writing his composition 'Tutu', and shares countless stories of the recording process of the album 'Tutu'. This documentary was filmed in 2009 at the 'We Want Miles' exhibition in Cité de la Musique in Paris.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, Ben Riley & Larry Gales
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop. Several concerts from his 1966 European tour were recorded for television, featuring his quartet of Charles Rouse (tenor saxophone), Lawrence Gales (bass) and Benjamin Riley (drums). His quartet performed Epistrophy, 'Round Midnight, and Lulu's Back in Town in Warsaw for Polish television on April 4, 1966. On April 17, the same quartet performed a short set in Copenhagen for Danish television, featuring Lulu's Back in Town, Don't Blame Me, and Epistrophy.

programme.title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas Vella
programme.sub-title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday. In 1971, Marvin Gaye released a major record in the history of soul music "What's Going On". Sly Johnson, accompanied by Nicholas Vella's keyboard, makes the hot music of this album groove, a monument of soul and rhythm'n'blues. A true message of love delivered by MarvinGaye, through the story of a Vietnam war veteran who returns home and sees only injustice, suffering and hatred. The abrasive groove of Sly Johnson and Nicholas Vella is a rich music at the crossroads of hip-hop, funk and jazz. Sly Johnson, a great regular of the stage, embarks with extreme generosity the audience in his musical universe, an irresistible performance.

programme.title: Charlie Haden
programme.sub-title: Charlie Haden & Orchestra - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1985, American jazz bassist and composer Charlie Haden performed a mesmerizing concert at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Known for his collaborations with free-jazz pioneer Ornette Coleman, Haden brought his own New Liberation Orchestra to the festival.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius's electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: Art Farmer
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Earl Hines
programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can't Believe That You're In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.” Marva Josie joins the group for soulful renditions of “A Sunday Kind of Love” and the well-known classic “Kansas City” before the set comes to a close with “Caravan,” which features a lengthy drum solo by Graham.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer, Budapest Festival Orchestra & Richard Goode
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The acclaimed American pianist (1943) is known for his interpretations of the Beethoven repertoire. Goode recorded all five Beethoven piano concertos with the BFO and Fischer, earning him exceptional critical acclaim and a Grammy Award nomination. As an encore, Goode performs the Sarabande from J. S. Bach's Partita in B-flat major, BWV 825. The program closes with Beethoven's famous Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on January 29, 2017.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra & Víkingur Ólafsson
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Simone Lamsma, Gianandrea Noseda & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Dutch violinist Simone Lamsma brings lyricism and fire to Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's virtuosic Violin Concerto, joining conductor Gianandrea Noseda and the London Symphony Orchestra. Tchaikovsky wrote the piece in 1878 on the shores of Lake Geneva, collaborating closely with his former student and lover, violinist Iosif Kotek. The composer initially intended to dedicate the piece to the young Kotek, but eventually dedicated it to another violinist, Leopold Auer, as he was afraid of the gossip the dedication would cause. This performance was recorded at the Barbican Hall in London, UK, on April 10, 2022.

programme.title: Frans Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus, Siobhan Stagg & Avery Amereau
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.

programme.title: David Bateson, Tuva Semmingsen, Cassandra Lemoine & Bjørn Fjæstad
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: The Moody Blues
programme.desc: Celebrating the 50th anniversary of their landmark album, Days of Future Passed, The Moody Blues took to the road to perform the entire LP live. This film, capturing an electric evening at The Sony Centre, Toronto, where the band was joined on stage by a full orchestra for the first time ever, is the definitive performance of this seminal album. This spectacle of a show features stunning visuals and a unique narration performed by Jeremy Irons, transporting the audience and viewer to the psychedelic dream world of their classic record. Including the iconic hits Nights In White Satin and Tuesday Afternoon, this film truly pays homage to five decades of musical mastery. In this impressive yet intimate auditorium, The Moody Blues have never sounded better.

programme.title: Radiohead
programme.sub-title: The King of Limbs: Live from the Basement
programme.desc: The King of Limbs: Live from the Basement is a 2011 live video album by the English alternative rock band Radiohead, performing their eighth album, The King of Limbs (2011).

programme.title: David Gilmour

programme.title: The Pink Panther 2
programme.desc: When legendary treasures from around the world are stolen, including the priceless Pink Panther diamond, Clouseau is assigned to a dream team of international detectives who are under pressure to bring the master thief to justice before he strikes again.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: "Match Point" is a drama about ambition, the seduction of wealth, love, and sexual passion. Perhaps most importantly, however, the story reveals the huge part luck plays in events, refuting the comforting misconception that more of life is under our control than really is.

programme.title: Mothers Of The Bride
programme.desc: Jenna is getting married, her mother is delighted until Jenna announces she wants to find her birth mother.

programme.title: 12 Days of Giving
programme.desc: When Baxter Billings wins a small fortune at his local mall, he decides to become a Secret Santa to the people in his hometown. His anonymous philanthropy is contagious and soon enough the joy of giving at Christmas spreads across town. Along the way, Baxter forms a close friendship with Pamela and her young son Westin. He thinks he might be falling for Pamela… but there's one problem, he's already engaged! This Christmas, Baxter will have to choose between keeping promises and following his heart…

programme.title: A Song For Christmas
programme.desc: A.k.a. Christmas SoloTwo single parents stumble into the possibility of love for Christmas, only to discover that their daughters are embroiled in a nasty rivalry at school. When the rivalry gets out of control, can hope and healing lead everyone to a peaceful and merry Christmas?

programme.title: The Return of Swamp Thing
programme.desc: In this tongue-in-cheek sequel, the benevolent bog creature falls for the vegetarian, plant-loving daughter of the evil scientist who created him. Contains mild violence.

programme.title: High Crimes
programme.desc: A woman's life becomes embroiled in a huge military cover-up when it's revealed her husband is not who he says he is.

programme.title: Scoop
programme.desc: An American journalism student in London scoops a big story, and begins an affair with an aristocrat as the incident unfurls.

programme.title: The King Of Comedy
programme.desc: A struggling comedian gambles his uncertain future on a crazy scheme to ransom his way onto television by kidnapping a popular talk show host.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: At a turning point in his life, a former tennis pro falls for an actress who happens to be dating his friend and soon-to-be brother-in-law.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: The legendary Cimmerian warrior, Conan, fights an epic battle against hulking rivals, horrific monsters, and impossible odds, as he realizes he is the only one who can save the great nations of Hyboria from an encroaching reign of supernatural evil.

programme.title: Dune
programme.desc: A Duke's son leads his warriors against an evil baron and tries to destroy a galaxy-wide 'spice' trade.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: A mortal teams with the god Horus in an alliance against Set, the god of darkness, who usurped Egypt's throne.

programme.title: Saving Santa
programme.desc: Once upon a time, Santa operated with just a small workshop and a few elves. But, as Christmas has grown ever bigger, Santa has been forced to innovate! Now his cleverest elves develop amazing technology, including a hologram to hide the North Pole and a time machine to allow Santa to deliver presents to every home in the world, in just the one night. Bernard is an elf who dreams of creating such inventions, but his job is to clean the reindeer stables! Yet when he creates an amazing Christmas memory machine, his luck might be changing. But Bernard's invention is broken by a curious elf, causing the North Pole's power to fail and the hologram hiding it to disappear. Now exposed to the outside world, it is spotted by Santa's enemy, Neville Baddington, who is determined to steal Santa's secrets for himself. The only person who can stop him is Bernard.

programme.title: The Magic Reindeer: The Flight Before Christmas
programme.desc: Niko the Reindeer enjoys his cool and carefree life in the Arctic, but that all changes when he is given his most surprising Christmas present ever - a little stepbrother named Jonni! Niko is unhappy about this new addition to the family, but when Jonni is kidnapped by eagles, Niko realises that it's down to him to fly off and rescue his brother!

programme.title: Elf Man
programme.desc: An Elf is left behind by Santa to help rescue the Harper family from a lousy Christmas. The Elf and the family get more than they bargained for, as the kids help the Elf discover his special powers and true identity as a budding superhero.

programme.title: You Can't Fight Christmas
programme.desc: Interior decorator and Christmas fanatic, Leslie Major, has the yearly task of decorating the lobby of the famed Chesterton Hotel. But one fateful day whilst working on a ladder to reach the top of the tree, she falls into the arms of Edmund James, the grandson of the hotel's owner. However, Edmund is all business and plans to put an end to the annual tradition. Can Leslie work her magic and teach him to love Christmas?

programme.title: Christmas With a Crown
programme.desc: When a successful woman returns to her hometown to revive her family's Christmas festival, she meets a dashing stranger who's volunteered to help organise the event. Sparks begin to fly between them, but little does she know that he's really a prince in disguise, longing to find the true spirit of the holidays! It will take a Christmas miracle of royal proportions for their hearts to meet as one.

programme.title: The Guardian
programme.desc: Little Miss Sunshine meets The Blind Side. Even losers can win! When an unlucky car salesman (Andy Garcia) finds himself thrown into caring for a homeless grifter (Dafne Keen) they embark on a cross country road trip to find her father. Loan sharks, side hustles and a lot of fun along the way, this car salesman soon discovers an old dog can learn new tricks.

programme.title: The True Don Quixote
programme.desc: Down on his luck, Danny (Tim Blake Nelson – HBO's Watchmen) escapes the world by diving deep into the fantasy novels that bring him comfort. Diving a little too deep, he soon begins to believe that he himself is a great knight. Grabbing his cardboard armour, a sword and roping in his trusty squire Sancho (Jacob Batalon), they embark on an insane adventure, where great lessons are learned.

programme.title: Acts of Violence
programme.desc: How far would you go for the one you love? For the MacGregor brothers, that question becomes a life-or-death decision that tests their strength, courage, and sense of family. When Mia, the fiance of Roman MacGregor (Ashton Holmes: Revenge, A History of Violence), is abducted into a human trafficking ring, Roman and brothers Brendan (Shawn Ashmore: X-Men, The Following) and Deklan (Cole Hauser: Rogue,Olympus Has Fallen) decide to save Mia on their own. Theyre guided by Det. Avery (Bruce Willis: Die Hard, The Sixth Sense), the cop on the case whose sense of duty will be pushed to its limits and challenged by his colleague on the case Det. Brooke Baker (Sophia Bush: One Tree Hill, Chicago Fire). As the MacGregors sidestep official boundaries to rescue Mia, every second counts. But are they prepared for the ACTS OF VIOLENCE theyre about to experience?

programme.title: Brothers in Arms
programme.desc: A tense and high octane thriller from the producer of Nightcrawler. Cal (Jai Courtney: Suicide Squad) is a by-the-book police officer. When his reckless half-brother, Oyster (Nat Wolff: The Fault in our Stars), is given an unfair prison sentence, Cal driven by his loyalty to family and fierce code of honour fights for Oyster in this gripping tale of brotherhood and sacrifice.

programme.title: Escape from Germany
programme.desc: In 1939, 85 American missionaries made a daring escape from Nazi Germany as Hitler closed borders in one of church history's most dramatic moments.

programme.title: Genius
programme.desc: Nicole Kidman and Colin Firth star in this stirring drama about the friendship between Thomas Wolfe and editor Maxwell Perkins (who discovered F. Scott Fitzgerald and Ernest Hemingway).

programme.title: Love Sarah
programme.desc: Three generations of women, led by Mimi will need to overcome grief, doubts and differences to honour the memory of their beloved Sarah, while embarking on a journey to establish a new bakery in Notting Hill, a place filled with love, hope and colourful pastries from all over the world.

programme.title: From Time to Time
programme.desc: In 1940s England, thirteen year old Tolly is sent to Green Knowe, the country estate of his grandmother, while his mother searches for any information concerning his missing in action father. Tolly soon finds that he can pass through time to witness the family stories Grandmother Oldknow tells him.

programme.title: A Very Country Christmas
programme.desc: (2017) Festive romance with Greyston Holt. A singer escapes the chaos of Hollywood to rediscover his love for country music. But what he stumbles upon is even better.

programme.title: It's Beginning to Look a Lot Like Christmas
programme.desc: (2019) Festive romance with Eric Mabius. When mayoral rivals Liam and Sarah enter a Christmas decorating contest, they end up with more than just Christmas spirit.

programme.title: Holiday Hotline
programme.desc: (2023) Phone-omenal romance with Emily Tennant. There's love on the line when a woman working at a switchboard connects with a charming anonymous caller - but she doesn't realise they've already met.

programme.title: Maggie's Christmas Miracle
programme.desc: A single mother must balance her career and raising her son whilst romance begins to spark between her and her son's tutor. Starring Jill Wagner (2017)

programme.title: Christmas Everlasting
programme.desc: (2018) Festive drama with Tatyana Ali. A lawyer returns to her home town after her sister's death, and discovers the will requires her to stay for 30 days over Christmas to inherit the family home.

programme.title: The Sun is Also a Star
programme.desc: “What if I told you I could get you to fall in love with me…?” College-bound romantic Daniel Bae (Melton) and Jamaica-born pragmatist Natasha Kingsley (Shahidi) meet—and fall for each other—over one magical day amidst the fervor and flurry of New York City...

programme.title: Made for You, with Love
programme.desc: The owner of a second hand wedding dress business breathes new life into used dresses, making dreams come true for brides unable to afford pricey gowns. But when she meets the perfect guy, she's afraid to give her own heart a second chance at love.

programme.title: Meet Me in New York
programme.desc: Kelly is a young, creative, ambitious events planner in New York City and quickly gaining a reputation as one of the best in the business. But when Joe, an influential website editor, hires her to organize his niece's 10th birthday party, Kelly quickly realizes that she may have just met her match.

programme.title: Tailor-Made Romance
programme.desc: A struggling designer takes a job as a personal stylist for a grumpy but ridiculously handsome billionaire. As she revamps his wardrobe and he teaches her about business, they realize they just might be the perfect fit.

programme.title: Holiday in The Hamptons
programme.desc: A woman inherits her grandfather's home in the Hamptons and reconnects with her childhood love.

programme.title: Return To Me
programme.desc: A man who falls in love with the woman who received his wife's heart must decide which woman it is who holds his heart.

programme.title: Love Under The Stars
programme.desc: When a 30-something woman living in an infinite state of youth is finally forced out into the real world, she befriends a young girl and a widower that will teach her that it is okay to grow up.

programme.title: The Christmas Lodge
programme.desc: During a weekend trip to the mountains, Mary finds herself at the now run-down lodge where she spent the holidays with her family growing up. She becomes determined to restore the building to its former glory

programme.title: Bookworm and the Beast
programme.desc: Izzy is ready to make a difference in the world as she starts her career in public relations. When Grant Beiste - the big-headed corporate celebrity in town - accidentally hits her father with a car, Izzy is thrown into a public scandal that forces her to work closely with Grant. As she fights to save both her father and Grant's public image, she falls in love and learns not to judge a book by it's cover.

programme.title: A Royal Surprise
programme.desc: When Riley's boyfriend, Mandla, invites her to South Africa to meet his family, she is shocked to discover that he is a prince. The news puts Riley's trust in Mandla in jeopardy, and he must do what he can to win her love back.

programme.title: Tails of Christmas
programme.desc: A military veteran searches for purpose in his life after an injury cut his career short. He finds it in a kind woman who runs an animal shelter. As they work together to find animals homes during the Christmas adoption season, they develop feelings for each other, and help each other with the challenges each faces.

programme.title: 12 Days of Giving
programme.desc: After winning a $50,000 prize, a man decides to pay things forward by buying Christmas gifts for strangers under the pseudonym "Lucky the Elf."

programme.title: Four Christmases and a Wedding
programme.desc: Chloe (Arielle Kebbel) is hired to plan the local Christmas Festival.

programme.title: Last Chance for Christmas.
programme.desc: Santa's handsome but beleaguered stable master John must rush off to Alaska.

programme.title: The Psycho She Met Online
programme.desc: While her husband heals from a car crash, Karen bonds with their new renter—until another houseguest vanishes.

programme.title: All for Love
programme.desc: After 73 errors about firefighters in her last romance novel, Jo's publisher, Diana, insists on weeks of research for her next book by training at a military boot camp run by her navy seal brother.

programme.title: Her Boyfriend Secret
programme.desc: After believing she has found the guy of her dreams, Melissa soon learns that her dream man has a dark secret.

programme.title: Happily Never After

When problems begin to rise during the creative process, Kate and Josh decide to relive their past forcing them to fall in love all over again.

programme.title: Daddy Day Camp

With some quick thinking, teamwork, a secret weapon and some off-the-wall crazy antics, the dads and kids unite to make sure DADDY DAY CAMP secures its rightful place in kid camp history!

His ex-wife, Goldie Hawn, is a liberal lawyer married to the local district attorney. When Chase arrives at their home seeking shelter, she takes him in and their passions are rekindled.

programme.title: Made Of Honor
programme.desc: A guy in love with an engaged woman tries to win her over after she asks him to be her maid of honor.

programme.title: Maid In Manhattan

When her real identity is revealed, the truth sets in about the disparity of their lives.

programme.title: Rome Express

programme.title: Iron Fury

programme.title: Larry Graham
programme.sub-title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham & Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers' came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career. It is often said that Graham pioneered the art of slap-pop playing on the electric bass, which has become a staple of modern funk. During this Paris performance, Graham shows he is one of the heroes of funk!

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Tony Bennett
programme.desc: Relive the magic of one of the most beloved crooners in music history in his prime: Tony Bennett! Recorded live in London's Royal Albert Hall on March 2, 1974, this enchanting performance showcases Bennett's remarkable vocal prowess and charisma to full effect. Bennett is accompanied by his musical director Torrie Zito and an orchestra of British musicians that includes Kenny Clare (drums), Don Lusher (trombone), and Kenny Baker (trumpet). Tune in for Bennett's captivating take on songs “The Good Things in Life”, “My Favorite Things”, “My Love”, “I've Got Five Dollars”, “It Don't Mean a Thing”, and “Maybe This Time” in this magical concert recording.

programme.title: Marcus Miller
programme.desc: This portrait of Marcus Miller was recorded during his 2009 ‘Tutu Revisited' tour. Miller looks back on his relationship with Miles Davis. Miller tells us about writing his composition 'Tutu', and shares countless stories of the recording process of the album 'Tutu'. This documentary was filmed in 2009 at the 'We Want Miles' exhibition in Cité de la Musique in Paris.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, Ben Riley & Larry Gales
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop. Several concerts from his 1966 European tour were recorded for television, featuring his quartet of Charles Rouse (tenor saxophone), Lawrence Gales (bass) and Benjamin Riley (drums). His quartet performed Epistrophy, 'Round Midnight, and Lulu's Back in Town in Warsaw for Polish television on April 4, 1966. On April 17, the same quartet performed a short set in Copenhagen for Danish television, featuring Lulu's Back in Town, Don't Blame Me, and Epistrophy.

programme.title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas Vella
programme.sub-title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday. In 1971, Marvin Gaye released a major record in the history of soul music "What's Going On". Sly Johnson, accompanied by Nicholas Vella's keyboard, makes the hot music of this album groove, a monument of soul and rhythm'n'blues. A true message of love delivered by MarvinGaye, through the story of a Vietnam war veteran who returns home and sees only injustice, suffering and hatred. The abrasive groove of Sly Johnson and Nicholas Vella is a rich music at the crossroads of hip-hop, funk and jazz. Sly Johnson, a great regular of the stage, embarks with extreme generosity the audience in his musical universe, an irresistible performance.

programme.title: Charlie Haden
programme.sub-title: Charlie Haden & Orchestra - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1985, American jazz bassist and composer Charlie Haden performed a mesmerizing concert at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Known for his collaborations with free-jazz pioneer Ornette Coleman, Haden brought his own New Liberation Orchestra to the festival.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius's electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: Art Farmer
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Earl Hines
programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can't Believe That You're In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.” Marva Josie joins the group for soulful renditions of “A Sunday Kind of Love” and the well-known classic “Kansas City” before the set comes to a close with “Caravan,” which features a lengthy drum solo by Graham.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer, Budapest Festival Orchestra & Richard Goode
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The acclaimed American pianist (1943) is known for his interpretations of the Beethoven repertoire. Goode recorded all five Beethoven piano concertos with the BFO and Fischer, earning him exceptional critical acclaim and a Grammy Award nomination. As an encore, Goode performs the Sarabande from J. S. Bach's Partita in B-flat major, BWV 825. The program closes with Beethoven's famous Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on January 29, 2017.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra & Víkingur Ólafsson
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Simone Lamsma, Gianandrea Noseda & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Dutch violinist Simone Lamsma brings lyricism and fire to Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's virtuosic Violin Concerto, joining conductor Gianandrea Noseda and the London Symphony Orchestra. Tchaikovsky wrote the piece in 1878 on the shores of Lake Geneva, collaborating closely with his former student and lover, violinist Iosif Kotek. The composer initially intended to dedicate the piece to the young Kotek, but eventually dedicated it to another violinist, Leopold Auer, as he was afraid of the gossip the dedication would cause. This performance was recorded at the Barbican Hall in London, UK, on April 10, 2022.

programme.title: Frans Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus, Siobhan Stagg & Avery Amereau
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.

programme.title: David Bateson, Tuva Semmingsen, Cassandra Lemoine & Bjørn Fjæstad
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: Neil Young
programme.desc: Following on from this label's previous Neil Young DVD documentary, The First Decade, comes this second instalment focusing on the great man's career between the years 1976 and 2006 with the help of obscure archive footage, rare film of Neil Young in performance and in the studio and contributions from those he worked with closely during this period.

programme.title: Tom Petty & The Heartbreakers

programme.title: The Moody Blues
programme.desc: Celebrating the 50th anniversary of their landmark album, Days of Future Passed, The Moody Blues took to the road to perform the entire LP live. This film, capturing an electric evening at The Sony Centre, Toronto, where the band was joined on stage by a full orchestra for the first time ever, is the definitive performance of this seminal album. This spectacle of a show features stunning visuals and a unique narration performed by Jeremy Irons, transporting the audience and viewer to the psychedelic dream world of their classic record. Including the iconic hits Nights In White Satin and Tuesday Afternoon, this film truly pays homage to five decades of musical mastery. In this impressive yet intimate auditorium, The Moody Blues have never sounded better.

programme.desc: La ganadora del Premio Nobel, Maria Linde (Krystyna Janda), una mujer de espíritu libre que vive junto a su familia en la cálida Toscana, mantiene un affaire con un joven egipcio dueño de un hotel de la playa cercana.

programme.title: Cowboys
programme.desc: Troy y su joven hijo transgénero, Joe, se escapan juntos para alejarse de la conservadora madre del niño, a través de la naturaleza salvaje de Montana.

programme.title: La buena mentira
programme.desc: Una película conmovedora, honesta y con mucho corazón que aborda la experiencia de la inmigración con elegancia. Un grupo de refugiados sudaneses que conviven en Kansas, EE.UU. conocen a una trabajadora social (Reese Witherspoon) que cambiará sus vidas para siempre.

programme.title: Una sorpresa real
programme.desc: Cuando el novio de Riley la invita a Sudáfrica para conocer a su familia, ella se sorprende.

programme.title: Para Toda la Vida
programme.desc: Una madre lucha por cuidar a su bebé mientras el padre se aleja de ellos.

programme.desc: ¿Podrías encontrar a tu amor verdadero haciendo surf?

programme.title: Eva
programme.desc: Un dramaturgo se refugia en un chalet durante una nevada y conoce a una mujer misteriosa.

programme.title: Para Toda la Vida

programme.title: Un romance con Fígaro
programme.desc: Una brillante y joven administradora de fondos, decide dejar atrás su trabajo y su novio de muchos años, para perseguir su sueño de convertirse en cantante de ópera.

programme.title: Pequeño Manhattan
programme.desc: Little Manhattan es una agradable comedia perfecta tanto para niños como para adultos. En una ciudad conocida por su agitación, dos jóvenes amigos se embarcan en la mayor aventura de su vida.

programme.title: Solo nos queda bailar
programme.desc: Merab ha entrenado desde joven en el grupo de danza nacional de Georgia con su compañera de baile Mary. Su mundo se ve sacudido con la llegada de Irakli, quien pronto se convierte en su mayor rival y deseo. En este entorno conservador, Merab se ve obligado a liberarse y arriesgarlo todo.

programme.title: El sueño de una noche de verano
programme.desc: Enamórate. Diviértete. Comienza una noche mágica... Un reparto estelar en una maravillosa comedia llena de descabelladas pasiones, peligrosas pociones y espíritus traviesos.

programme.title: El grito de la lechuza
programme.desc: Robert es un joven en pleno proceso de divorcio que se aleja de la gran ciudad para refugiarse en la tranquilidad de un pequeño…

programme.title: El mundo resplandeciente
programme.desc: En el mismo instante que la pequeña Margaret descubre la naturaleza violenta de la relación de sus padres, su hermana gemela muere ahogada en una piscina.

programme.title: Oxford Blues
programme.desc: Nick, un impetuoso y atractivo atleta norteamericano que trabaja como guardacoches en Las Vegas, se va a la universidad inglesa de Oxford siguiendo a la chica de sus sueños. Allí, al principio, todo serán problemas, desde que aparece con un llamativo T-Bird del 57, que Nick utiliza para atraer a Lady Victoria en el severo y otoñal ambiente universitario. Pronto encuentra un rival, Colin, el novio oficial de Victoria. A la vez, Rona, una chica norteamericana también matriculada en Oxford, se siente atraída por Nick, pero éste parece no tenerla demasiado en cuenta...

programme.title: Todo por Grace
programme.desc: Hawai, 1920. Un joven doctor llega a la isla para atender a los trabajadores de las plantaciones de café. Allí conoce a Jo, un pequeño huérfano local que el doctor adopta y a quien toma como ayudante. El niño se convierte en su mensajero entre las distintas plantaciones y pueblos, llevando las medicinas que necesitan los enfermos. Sin embargo, todo cambiará cuando Jo se enamore de la hija del terrateniente de la plantación.

programme.title: El Forastero
programme.desc: El forastero procede de un planeta arrasado por el desorden medioambiental y la lluvia radiactiva.

programme.title: Trinidad y Bambino... (Tal Para Cual)
programme.desc: Trinidad descubre que Bambino fue condenado injustamente y huye con él para buscar a los culpables.

programme.title: Sharknado 4: Que La 4 Te Acompañe
programme.desc: Un extraño Sharknado de arena golpea Las Vegas, Fin vuelve a la acción y lucha contra el Sharknado.

programme.title: El Embajador de la India
programme.desc: Jaime Flórez¸ provinciano astuto y malicioso¸ se ve envuelto en el equívoco en una ciudad colombiana.

programme.title: El Forastero
programme.desc: El forastero procede de un planeta arrasado por el desorden medioambiental y la lluvia radiactiva.

programme.title: El tesoro perdido
programme.desc: Durante el asedio de Kazán por parte de Iván el Terrible, la esposa del gran kan ocultó una fortuna en el lago Kaban. 500 años después, un hombre sin blanca encuentra un mapa que conduce al tesoro pero no es el único que lo codicia.

programme.title: Querida Elizabeth
programme.desc: Un hombre que lleva una vida aburrida accidentalmente acecha en las redes sociales a una antigua compañera de universidad, la actriz Elizabeth Banks. Redescubre más de sí mismo y el verdadero significado de la amistad en sus intentos por demostrar que la conoce.

programme.title: Más extraño que la ficción
programme.desc: Una mañana, un agente de Hacienda aparentemente normal y generalmente solitario llamado Harold Crick empieza a escuchar una voz femenina que narra todas sus acciones, pensamientos y sentimientos con un detalle alarmantemente preciso.

programme.title: Corrupción en el poder (Casino Jack)
programme.desc: Jack Abramoff, un poderoso y corrupto lobista republicano, que se enriqueció mediante múltiples fraudes y sobornos que realizó, aprovechándose de las tribus de indios a quienes representaba en el Congreso. Inspirada en hechos reales, fue uno de los grandes escándalos de la política en Whasington.

programme.title: Un Diploma Muy Caro
programme.desc: John Plummer (Jason Lee) es un hombre trabajador como cualquier otro que está a punto de casarse con su novia desde hace muchos años, Elaine (Leslie Mann), ahora que han ahorrado 30 000 dólares para el pago inicial de la casa de sus sueños. Pero, años antes, John hizo la olvidada promesa de pagar la matrícula de su sobrina Noreen (Tammy Blanchard) si entraba a una buena universidad. Milagrosamente, Noreen fue aceptada nada más y nada menos que en la Universidad de Harvard, y ahora lo único que necesita de su tío John son otros 29 879 dólares para su matrícula. Como no puede decirle a Elaine que necesita ganar 30 000 dólares adicionales en dos semanas, John recurre a su amigo Duff (Tom Green), quien lo convence de involucrarse por un corto tiempo en delitos menores. La vida de John rápidamente se derrumba cuando cada uno de los alocados timos de Duff se sale de control.

programme.title: Ricki
programme.desc: Ricki es la líder de un grupo de música que se dedica a interpretar versiones de canciones de otros artistas, que buscando perseguir su sueño de ser una estrella de rock decidió abandonar a sus tres hijos y a su marido. Pero años después de dejar atrás a su familia tendrá que enfrentarse a la realidad cuando regrese para ayudar a su hija que está pasando por una mala situación.

programme.title: Mr. Deeds
programme.desc: Deeds (Adam Sandler) es un ingenuo provinciano que vive en un pueblo de New Hampshire. Como propietario de "Deeds' Pizza", la única pizzeria del pueblo, se ha hecho muy popular por su particular manera de entretener a los clientes recitándoles sus insólitos poemas. La vida transcurre plácidamente hasta que recibe la noticia de que un pariente lejano le ha dejado una herencia de cuarenta billones de dólares, una cadena de medios de comunicación, un equipo de fútbol, un equipo de baloncesto y un helicóptero privado.

programme.title: Zohan: Licencia Para Peinar
programme.desc: Zohan es un agente de élite del Mossad que guarda un secreto: su sueño es convertirse en peluquero en Estados Unidos. Aprovechando una pelea contra su peor enemigo, un terrorista conocido como ‘El Fantasma', Zohan finge su propia muerte y vuela a Nueva York, armado únicamente con sus tijeras y su secador de pelo.A pesar de su inexperiencia, pronto es contratado por el dueño de una peluquería y consigue atraer a una gran multitud de clientes. Sin embargo, el sueño de Zohan corre peligro cuando su antiguo enemigo le reconoce y planea acabar con él de una vez por todas.

programme.title: Doc West
programme.desc: Después de ser despojado de sus ganancias en un juego de póquer, Doc West busca venganza. Durante una partida en un pueblo, acaba en la cárcel, y cuando su pasado se revela, el pueblo estalla en una batalla a tiros. Doc deberá decidir si unirse a los forajidos o apoyar a los ciudadanos honrados.

programme.title: Recopilación Bonanza Episodios 22, 23, 24
programme.desc: Las aventuras del Salvaje Oeste de Ben Cartwright y sus hijos mientras dirigen y defienden su rancho de Nevada al tiempo que ayudan a la comunidad de los alrededores.

programme.title: Winnetou
programme.desc: Mientras los assiniboins entran en guerra con los colonos, Winnetou intenta mantener la paz. Un petrolero sin escrúpulos, Bud Forrester, provoca ataques falsos para iniciar un conflicto y quedarse con tierras ricas en petróleo. Old Shatterhand, Winnetou y Lord Castlepool unen fuerzas para detenerlo antes de que estalle la guerra.

programme.title: Río Lobo
programme.desc: Tras la Guerra Civil, Cord McNally busca al traidor cuya traición causó la derrota de la unidad de McNally y la pérdida de un amigo íntimo.

programme.title: Cada día
programme.desc: Una comedia sobre una pareja de Nueva York en una crisis romántica y familiar.

programme.title: Lo peor de los deseos
programme.desc: Esta historia se centra en una joven pareja, cuando uno de ellos se ve obligado a enfrentar una maldición antigua cuando le hace una pregunta a una vieja máquina de juguetes. La película explora la idea de los deseos y su poder para cambiar nuestras vidas.

programme.title: El fuego inolvidable
programme.desc: Un grupo de jóvenes trazan un plan y están dispuestos a hacer un cambio en el mundo que los rodea, a pesar de la amenaza de la realidad.

programme.title: Diallelos
programme.desc: Dos estafadores locales se proponen jugar con una ingenua empresaria japonesa, robarle una gran suma de dinero y además cobrar venganza. Pero no todo sale como lo planeado cuando la mujer no es tan inocente como se imaginan y además uno de ellos se enamora.

programme.title: El pequeño Nicolás
programme.desc: Inclinados sobre un gran folio en blanco en algún lugar entre Montmartre y Saint-Germain-des-Prés, Jean-Jacques Sempé y René Goscinny dan vida a El pequeño Nicolás, un niño risueño y travieso. La suya es una infancia alegre, llena de juegos, diversión, bromas, aprendizaje, complicidad, peleas y castigos. Las aventuras de Nicolás le llevan al estudio de sus creadores, donde habla con ellos de forma distendida. Sempé y Goscinny le cuentan cómo se conocieron y se hicieron amigos, y también responden a preguntas sobre su carrera, su infancia y sus ambiciones.

programme.title: El proyecto Colibrí
programme.desc: Dos primos intentan hacerse millonarios mediante la construcción de un cable de fibra óptica entre Kansas y Nueva Jersey, mientras su antigua jefa intenta evitar que lo consigan

programme.title: Mi amigo Blue
programme.desc: Una icónica historia de amistad entre un muchacho y un perro único y desgarbado que se convertiría en una leyenda australiana.

programme.title: Prácticamente muerto
programme.desc: Clahan es un sacerdote protestante que dirige a un grupo de fanáticos de la supremacía blanca. Un día, durante un sermón, es asesinado por un extremista de izquierdas. Su inconsolable viuda, dispuesta a vengarse, busca la ayuda de dos fanáticos, que secuestran y torturan a un hombre al que creen culpable.

programme.title: El sueño de Valentín
programme.desc: 1960, Buenos Aires. Valentín es un niño de nueve años que vive con su abuela. Su madre desapareció cuando él tenía tres años y su padre es un hombre descontrolado e incapaz de asumir responsabilidades. Valentín es un niño solitario que busca constantemente amor y cariño.

programme.title: Amalia en el otoño
programme.desc: Isabel está preocupada por su madre Amalia, en una residencia.. Poco después, la COVID-19 aparece en la vida de todos.

programme.title: La final
programme.desc: Tres amigos hinchas del Atlético Madrid y tres chicas seguidoras del Real Madrid: todos protagonizan una historia de amor la semana de la final de Champions. Aure y Andrea tienen una tensión sexual no resuelta desde la adolescencia, fruto de la casualidad, surge el reencuentro.

programme.title: Benidorm mon amour
programme.desc: Tonet aprovecha un permiso de la mili para ir en coche con sus amigos Sento, Jaume y Tomy a Benidorm. Sueñan con disfrutar unos días del sol, las playas y, sobre todo, de las suecas y sus biquinis.

programme.title: Seven Dorms of Death
programme.desc: Seven Dorms of Death tells the tale of a cursed stage play that is about to be performed at a New England college. Unfortunately for the director, the young cast, and anyone else unlucky enough to be involved with the production, someone has deadly plans for the play! Can a pair of homicide detectives and a student with psychic powers solve the mystery before it's too late'

programme.title: Los misterios de Fixer Upper
programme.desc: Shannon es la encargada de restaurar una mansión victoriana. Las renovaciones van perfectamente hasta que el jefe del banco local es encontrado muerto.

programme.title: Circle Spanish Dub
programme.desc: En este emocionante thriller, el FBI se une a los alguaciles estadounidenses en la búsqueda de un sociópata fugitivo, James Bennett, después de que comete una serie de asesinatos meticulosamente planeados. Para complicar aún más las cosas, se enteran de que Bennet se dirige a la casa de su infancia, donde un grupo de estudiantes graduados estudian su entorno para escribir su tesis.

programme.title: Madam Yankelova's Fine Literature Club
programme.desc: Members of a secret, all-female club lure unsuspecting men to their weekly meetings, murder them, and grind them into hot dogs. When Sophie meets an attractive young man, she must soon choose between true love and her loyalty to her fellow women.

programme.title: Breach
programme.desc: A punto de convertirse en padre, un joven mecánico a bordo de un arca interestelar rumbo a la Nueva Tierra debe ingeniárselas para vencer a un terror cósmico maligno que pretende usar la nave espacial como arma.

programme.title: Exoplaneta Dune en Peligro
programme.desc: Una tripulación en misión para salvar una base abandonada en un planeta desértico se convierte en mortal cuando son acechados y atacados por los principales depredadores del planeta: gusanos de arena gigantes.

programme.title: El Comando
programme.desc: Un agente de la DEA que sufre un trastorno de estrés postraumático debe proteger a su familia de un ataque a su casa después de que un delincuente convicto y sus secuaces vengan a buscar su alijo de millones dentro de la casa del agente.

programme.title: Santos y soldados
programme.desc: Cuatro soldados estadounidenses y un británico durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial luchan por regresar al territorio aliado después de ser separados de las fuerzas estadounidenses durante la histórica Masacre de Malmedy.

programme.title: Bus Driver
programme.desc: Un autobús escolar que se dirige a un retiro sufre un pinchazo y se detiene en el rancho más cercano en busca de ayuda. El conductor, cinco estudiantes problemáticos y su ridículo profesor de gimnasia como acompañante se encuentran, en cambio, con criminales dispuestos a todo para que sus operaciones de drogas no sean descubiertas. Los estudiantes y el profesor son presas fáciles para estos delincuentes, pero entre ellos y una muerte segura se interpone una fuerza más decidida y hábil de lo que jamás imaginaron: el conductor del autobús.

programme.title: El hombre del presidente I
programme.desc: Joshua McCord es un agente del servicio secreto retirado al que le encargan la misión de entrenar a un joven. Sin embargo, cuando la Primera Dama es secuestrada por terroristas, se encuentra inmerso en una misión de 'todo o nada'.

programme.title: Tracers

'Tracers' está ambientada en el espectacular mundo del parkour, una técnica de desplazamiento en la que hay que superar todos los obstáculos usando las habilidades del cuerpo humano: saltando vallas, muros, etc.

programme.title: The Unthinkable

Un poderoso avión espía experimental es robado por un malvado traficante de armas y está a punto de ser vendido a un grupo terrorista internacional. El gobierno de los Estados Unidos prepara a un boxeador egocéntrico (Murphy) para que se una al sofisticado agente especial (Wilson) en una peligrosa misión secreta para recuperar el avión. Armado con los últimos artilugios tecnológicos y mucho carácter, esta extraña pareja podría ser capaz de salvar el mundo, si se pudiesen llevar bien.
